title: ScotRail New App Faces Technical Issues
description: ScotRail's new app has encountered technical problems, leading to difficulties for passengers booking tickets.

sources.title: ScotRail apology as passengers unable to book tickets in app launch chaos
ScotRail issues urgent warning to passengers ahead of app change tomorrow
Roll out of new ScotRail app hit by technical problems

sections.heading: App Launch Issues
paragraphs: ScotRail has issued an apology to passengers who have been unable to book tickets due to technical issues with their newly launched app, as reported by BBC.

sections.heading: Urgent Warning
paragraphs: Glasgow Times reports that ScotRail has issued an urgent warning to passengers ahead of the app change, advising them to download tickets in advance.

sections.heading: Technical Problems
paragraphs: The Herald details that the roll out of the new ScotRail app has been hit by technical problems, causing disruptions for users.

faq.q: What is the issue with ScotRail's new app?
faq.a: The new ScotRail app has technical problems that are preventing passengers from booking tickets.

faq.q: Has ScotRail responded to the app issues?
faq.a: Yes, ScotRail has issued an apology to passengers affected by the app launch chaos, according to BBC.

faq.q: What advice has ScotRail given to passengers?
faq.a: ScotRail has warned passengers to download tickets in advance due to the app issues, as reported by Glasgow Times.
